subject: Request: partner credits for GreenStart pilot / Nexus Accelerator coordination
messages:
From: Nexus Accelerator <ops@nexus-accelerator.org>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: BlueBridge SI <partnerships@bluebridge.co>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-provided credits for GreenStart pilot

Hi Marissa,

Quick intro — I'm Avery (ops) at Nexus Accelerator. We have an incoming cohort company, GreenStart Labs (contact: Ella Park), that will run a 6-week technical pilot in October and their primary infra is Redwood. BlueBridge (cc'd) is the SI helping with integration.

Nexus is prepared to provide $15k in promotional credits via the cloud marketplace (to be applied as a partner-funded promo) to seed the pilot. Before we proceed we need to confirm redemption steps and whether Redwood can: 

- Accept partner-sourced promotional credits routed through a marketplace entity
- Apply credits to a single startup account for a 6-week pilot
- Provide a short usage estimate and an activation ETA so we can align our onboarding schedule

I've attached a short intent memo. Can someone on your team confirm the process and approximate time to activate once Marketplace voucher is issued?

Thanks,
Avery (Nexus Accelerator)
attachments: Nexus_CoFunding_Intent.pdf
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: ops@nexus-accelerator.org
Cc: partnerships@bluebridge.co, ben_carter@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-provided credits for GreenStart pilot

Thanks Avery — great to meet you. Welcome, Ella.

Short answers up front: yes, we can accept partner-sourced marketplace credits and apply them to a single customer account for a fixed pilot window. Typical steps are below; I'll loop in Ben (sales) for billing-side acceptance and Priya for compliance sign-off.

High-level process:
- Marketplace voucher issued by Nexus/BlueBridge -> Redwood marketplace team redeems to a partner credit pool
- Partner ops routes a credit grant request to Redwood (we need recipient account email & expected start date)
- Redwood creates a time-bound promo allocation applied to the customer account (can include term/usage caps)
- We send confirmation + activation link to the customer and CC partner

For sizing, if GreenStart expects light experimentation (embedding + gen calls) for 6 weeks, ballpark is 20-40k tokens/day. I'll ask the runtime team for a short estimate based on your usage profile and attach a simple CSV.

Ben / Priya — can you confirm (1) any paperwork needed on your side, (2) expected SLA on activation once we receive the voucher ID, and (3) whether we require any special compliance review for Nexus-managed credits?

— Marissa
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-provided credits for GreenStart pilot

Looping in Soojin for marketplace ops. Quick notes:

- Paperwork: we generally require a short co-funding letter (signed by Nexus) that specifies voucher amount, target account, and any spend constraints. The attached Nexus_CoFunding_Intent.pdf is close — will ask Nexus for a signature.
- Activation SLA: once the voucher is redeemed into our partner pool and we receive the voucher ID + recipient email, ops can create the allocation within 24–48 business hours (unless we hit manual compliance hold).
- Accounting: charges will consume partner credits first; we'll report usage in the customer invoice as $0 up to the credit amount, then bill overage normally.

Soojin — please prep a short activation checklist and confirm whether we need any additional KYC for Nexus as a marketplace partner.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-provided credits for GreenStart pilot

Thanks — checklist below. No KYC beyond standard marketplace connector review for Nexus (we already have Nexus as a listed accelerator partner).

Activation checklist (ops):
1) Confirm voucher redemption into Redwood partner pool (voucher ID)
2) Receive signed Co-Funding Letter from Nexus (PDF) with recipient email & start/end dates
3) Verify recipient account email is existing Redwood account (or provisorily create with customer consent)
4) Create a time-bound promo allocation and attach usage caps (if requested)
5) Notify customer, Nexus, and BlueBridge with activation link and redemption terms

If Nexus can send signed letter + voucher ID this week we can target activation by Sep 6–7.

— Soojin
Marketplace Operations
From: Ella Park <ella@greenstartlabs.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ops@nexus-accelerator.org, partnerships@bluebridge.co
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-provided credits for GreenStart pilot

Hi Marissa / team — thanks for the speedy reply. A couple quick details from our side:

- Recipient account email: trials+greenstart@greenstartlabs.com (we'll grant access to the engineering lead)
- Pilot start: Oct 4, expected end: Nov 12 (6 weeks)
- Expected workload: embedding-heavy evaluation with occasional 1–2k-token generation calls; I attached our internal estimate CSV.

Would Nexus be able to send the signed co-funding letter and voucher ID by Sep 6? That would help us onboard before the pilot start.

Best,
Ella
CTO, GreenStart Labs
attachments: greenstart-usage-estimate.csv
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: ops@nexus-accelerator.org, partnerships@bluebridge.co, ella@greenstartlabs.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-provided credits for GreenStart pilot — confirmation and next steps

Thanks everyone — quick update and next steps: 

- Nexus: once you have the signed Co-Funding Letter and the marketplace voucher ID, please send both to ops@nexus-accelerator.org and cc soojin_lee@redwood.com.
- Ops SLA: Redwood will provision the time-bound promo within 48 business hours of voucher redemption and paperwork receipt.
- Usage estimate: runtime team reviewed Ella's CSV and recommends allocating 1.0M tokens for the pilot (we attached a short estimate to the HubSpot deal). That should map to the $15k Nexus intends to supply; Ben will reconcile in billing once voucher is live.
- Activation date: target Sep 8–10 for provisioning so GreenStart can complete onboarding the week of Sep 13 if needed; final activation will respect the Oct 4 pilot start if you prefer exact start gating.

Action items: 
- Nexus: send signed Co-Funding Letter + voucher ID (due Sep 6 ideally) — ops@nexus-accelerator.org
- BlueBridge / GreenStart: confirm recipient contact for onboarding and any required RBAC
- Ben / Priya / Soojin: monitor for any compliance holds and confirm when allocation is created.

Appreciate the partnership — happy to expedite if Nexus needs an internal sign-off template.

— Marissa
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
